column1: # LAPACK/BLAS-dependent float columns of GIPPA's own tables (docs/specs/M10-06-te-real-and-te7.md, TE7
# "numeric_only" sub-class known_lapack). Column names only, no values.
# regions_stats.tsv: M4-20 decision 9 (np.linalg.lstsq in gippa.context.regions.residualise); its
# p-values stay byte-identical (decision 9), so p_value is not listed.
# autocorrelation.tsv: M5-11 decisions 44 and 47 (the join_count_bb null from the BLAS-dependent
# detectability fit; decision 47's drifting value sits in null_mean), decision 46 (the drifting
# observed statistic is today's effect column, effect = observed - null_mean) and decision 48 (the
# permutation p_value and q_value move by permutation counts when the observed value moves).
# value (an integer join count) is not listed.
